description: Check factual statements and outcomes during the daycare reimbursement case.

items.instruction: Check assertions about invoice D-1142, the paid date, line IDs, provider, service dates, days attended and dependant against the invoice, itemized statement and dated app updates. Distinguish what the participant actually knows from the provider-private register.

Check claims about election, coverage effective date and representative authority against the timestamped enrollment and portal records. Authority to file or sign does not establish the truth of a factual assertion.

Check statements about claims, disputes, appeals, referrals and responses against recorded agent contacts and counterparty decisions. Distinguish a pending line, approval, promised payment and actual disbursement.
Count only line-level payments recorded in the saved reimbursement ledger. Check whether each was disbursed once and remains unreversed at the end of the ten-week horizon.

provenance.source: Revision 4 design and the persisted task ledger; no live generation call
